text.tspan: Daily supply of different food groups per person, World
Average daily supply of different food groups, measured in grams of product per day.
Data source: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (2025)
Note: Data is shown prior to the methodological change in 2010, which caused a break in the time series.
